question: Should ClawHub take ownership of a server-hosted, cross-device feed-watch inbox now, or keep notification delivery client-first until the listed privacy, consent, fanout, and signing prerequisites are met?
rationale: The branch deliberately adds durable account data and delivery behavior whose acceptable privacy, operational, and product boundaries cannot be selected from implementation details alone.

options.title: Keep the prototype parked
options.body: Leave this draft unmerged while client-side watches establish demand and the listed ownership prerequisites remain unresolved.

options.title: Sponsor a scoped server-hosted phase
options.body: Approve a reduced follow/feed or inbox slice with explicit ACL, retention, consent, operations, and upgrade requirements before requesting a rebased implementation.

options.title: Decline account-hosted delivery
options.body: Close the direction and retain local client watches as the supported notification model.

recommendation.title: Keep the prototype parked
recommendation.body: Leave this draft unmerged while client-side watches establish demand and the listed ownership prerequisites remain unresolved.

likelyOwner.reason: The available evidence identifies this author as the prototype's source, but a repository product owner must make the actual direction decision.
